about: The game's Xbox 360 XDK (2005) Direct3D library, as used by King Kong. Single source of names for the native renderer streams. Built by stream 01 (brief 01); see docs/d3d-api-map.md and docs/d3d-structs.md. Addresses are guest addresses; device offsets are bytes into the D3D device.

conventions.abi: PowerPC 64 ABI: integer and pointer arguments in r3-r10 in order; a float argument goes in the next free f register AND uses up its r slot (D3DDevice_Clear: Color r7, Z f1, Stencil r9). Returns in r3 or f1.
conventions.bits: Bit numbers are LSB = 0 unless the text says PowerPC (MSB = 0) numbering.

renderer.replace: the native renderer implements it; the original writes GPU packets
renderer.observe: keep the original and hook after it (resource create / lock / unlock / release)
renderer.keep: keep the original; it only updates the device struct, read it at draw time

status.verified: code read and matched with traced values or dumps
status.probable: role clear from the code, exact XDK name a best guess

setter_table.index: D3DRENDERSTATETYPE / 4 for render states 0-96; 97 + D3DSAMPLERSTATETYPE / 4 for sampler states

device.pending: qwords at +16, +24, +32, +40, +48 (MSB first); flushed by sub_82121040 at each draw

functions.notes: Reference count at device+12.

functions.name: D3DDevice_Release
functions.notes: Count at device+12; at 1 it tears the device down (sub_8211BA50) and frees it.

functions.name: D3DDevice_AcquireThreadOwnership
functions.notes: Owner thread id at device+10376.

functions.name: D3DDevice_ReleaseThreadOwnership
functions.notes: Clears device+10376.

functions.name: Direct3D_CreateDevice
functions.notes: Allocates the 20,608-byte device (128-aligned), sub_8211B838 sets up EDRAM, engines and the ring buffer. The engine stores the device at 0x82D62324 (GDI+4).

functions.name: D3DResource_AddRef
functions.notes: Common word bits 0-7 = reference count; a surface (type 4) also AddRefs its parent at +44.

functions.name: D3DResource_GetType
functions.notes: 1 SURFACE, 2 VOLUME, 3 TEXTURE, 4 VOLUMETEXTURE, 5 CUBETEXTURE, 6 VERTEXBUFFER, 7 INDEXBUFFER, 8 ARRAYTEXTURE, from Common bits 16-18 and the fetch constant dimension.

functions.name: D3DResource_Release
functions.notes: At count 1 with no device binding (Common bits 19-23 zero) frees through sub_82108D60: memory release is deferred until the GPU passes the fence at +4. Native: drop the host copy here.

functions.name: D3DResource_GetDevice
functions.notes: Returns the global device (AddRef).

functions.name: D3DDevice_CreateVertexBuffer
functions.notes: 20-byte object, data in physical memory; see d3d-structs.md.

functions.name: D3DVertexBuffer_Lock
functions.notes: Generic lock sub_82108EC0 (op 46): waits for the GPU if needed, lock count in Common bits 12-15.

functions.name: D3DVertexBuffer_Unlock
functions.notes: sub_821090E0: lock count down, flushes the CPU cache range. Native: re-upload the buffer (or mark dirty).

functions.name: D3DDevice_CreateIndexBuffer
functions.notes: 20-byte object; Common bit 31 = 32-bit indices.

functions.name: D3DIndexBuffer_Lock
functions.notes: op 47.
